claim: For the 16-point product minimal finite model \(T^2_{0,0}=C\times C\) of the torus, where \(C\) is the four-point minimal circle model, the 8,042,896 continuous self-maps induce exactly 25 endomorphisms of \(H_1(T^2_{0,0};\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z^2\) in the factor basis. Exactly 32 self-maps have rank-two action; they are precisely the 32 homeomorphisms, and their eight distinct homology matrices are the signed permutation matrices. In particular the shear matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}\), hence a Dehn-twist mapping class, is not directly realized by any self-map of this minimal finite model.

integrity.claim_scope: direct continuous self-maps of the 16-point product minimal finite torus model and their integral H1 actions
integrity.novelty_boundary: exact endomorphism count and homology-action image; minimality of the model is prior work
integrity.proof_core: dual cycle-cocycle basis plus exhaustive isotone-map enumeration

scientific_limitations: The classification is for the product 16-point minimal torus model T^2_{0,0}, not the second 16-point minimal torus model.
No obstruction is claimed after subdivision, refinement, or enlargement.
The complete census is computer-assisted but replayable by a deterministic exhaustive verifier.
Search noncoverage cannot exclude an obscure equivalent prior computation.
title: Homology-action rigidity of the 16-point product torus model
